component.name: DJDeX
component.summary: Professional Virtual DJ Workstation Powered by Rust

description.p: DJDeX By Kangpcode is a powerful cross-platform Virtual DJ desktop workstation engineered in Rust (Tauri 2) and React. Designed for seamless live performance, remixing, and broadcasting.

ul.li: Ultra-low latency real-time audio engine with CPAL and lock-free SPSC architecture
Dual and 4-deck playback with signalsmith-stretch time-stretching and key locking
Comprehensive 3-band / 4-band kill EQ, resonance filters, and 3-slot FX chains
Remixer / Sampler with 16-step drum machine sequencer and live sample packs
MIDI controller detection with interactive MIDI Learn and jog wheel relative decoding
Skin and Layout Engine with 4 factory presets (Classic Club, Battle Scratch, Producer Remix, Four-Deck Pro)
Master mix recorder (WAV 16/24/32-bit Float) and live streaming broadcast (Icecast 2 & SHOUTcast)

description.p: Final Workstation Release: Complete packaging for Windows, macOS, and Linux, CI/CD pipeline, and comprehensive documentation.
